title: Notice Worksheet
description: Pre-service worksheet and per-tenant service record for an annual rent-increase notice, from the B87 official-source kit. Case cells stay blank until verified.

sections.title: Owner inputs (case facts - not official findings)

rows.label: Unit 1 owner input
rows.notes: Last lease start February 1, 2025; $3,995; initial Tenant A/B/C. Official verification blank. Owner-supplied, anonymized; not official finding.

rows.label: Unit 1 continuing input
rows.notes: April 1, 2026; $3,995; Tenant A/D. Official verification blank. Owner-supplied; no new-tenancy or reset inference.

rows.label: Unit 2 owner input
rows.notes: June 1, 2019; $3,150; Tenant E/F. Official verification blank. Owner-supplied, anonymized.

rows.label: Location/building input
rows.notes: Outer Sunset, ZIP 94122; reportedly 1940; two units described as rent-controlled. Official verification blank. Owner-supplied; coverage unverified.

sections.title: Pre-service gates - every cell blank until verified

rows.label: Coverage gate
rows.notes: Many pre-June 14, 1979 units covered; exemptions exist; check PIM.

rows.label: Housing Inventory gate
rows.notes: All residential owners report; tenant-occupied covered units receive license; March 1 annual update.

rows.label: License effective-date gate
rows.notes: Rule 13.14 null/void if unlicensed on effective date; effective date not service date controls. See also B87-F02.

rows.label: Lease term gate
rows.notes: Fixed-term mid-term increase only if agreement expressly allows; actual lease unknown. See also B87-F07.

rows.label: Lawful base rent gate
rows.notes: Calculate on base rent; exclude temporary passthroughs; owner rent not verified lawful base.

rows.label: Anniversary gate
rows.notes: Rule 1.11 anniversary is date current rent became effective; next increase >=1 year; later increase resets.

rows.label: Rate gate
rows.notes: 1.6% effective 3/1/26-2/28/27; use rate on effective date.

rows.label: Banking gate
rows.notes: SF 24-month summary vs Rule 4.12 12-month formulation; no case banking inferred. See also B87-F03.

rows.label: Petition/passthrough gate
rows.notes: Annual/banked no petition; other routes have pre-notice filing rules.

rows.label: Subsidy gate
rows.notes: Tenant-based assistance may add notice requirements; status unknown.

rows.label: Repair/retaliation gate
rows.notes: Civil Code 1942.5 restrictions; neutral policy not safe harbor.

rows.label: Occupant-change gate
rows.notes: No extra rent merely for added occupant; 6.14/Costa-Hawkins facts not inferred.

rows.label: Written notice
rows.notes: Civil Code 827 written notice; SF dollar/percentage/effective date.

rows.label: Current/new base rent
rows.notes: State verified current and new base rent.

rows.label: Dollar/percentage
rows.notes: State dollar increase and percentage.

rows.label: Effective date
rows.notes: State effective date; rate and anniversary apply.

rows.label: Annual/banked breakdown
rows.notes: 37.3(b)(1) written annual/banked portion.

rows.label: Banked dates
rows.notes: Rule 4.12(b)(2) dates; include conservatively despite nullity wording differences. See also B87-F04.

rows.label: Other components
rows.notes: Identify/explain O&M, comps, capital, utility, bond, RAP components if any.

rows.label: Notice period
rows.notes: 30 days <=10%; 90 days >10% combined; CA mail +5; longer periods control.

rows.label: No rounding up
rows.notes: Base rent x allowed percentage; no rounding up.

rows.label: Neutral reason
rows.notes: Neutral annual-increase statement is drafting practice, not statutory reason requirement or safe harbor. See also B87-F08.

rows.label: Unit 1 conditional arithmetic
rows.notes: Assumes verified base, annual-only, rate window, no bars; unverified.

rows.label: Unit 2 conditional arithmetic
rows.notes: Assumes verified base, annual-only, rate window, no bars; unverified.

rows.label: Service method
rows.value: Personal delivery or CCP 1013 mail; no email/text/door/portal substitute in this kit.

rows.label: Mail extension
rows.value: +5 CA, +10 elsewhere US, +20 outside US; DRE 35/95 examples.

rows.label: Mail mechanics
rows.value: Sealed, postage paid, proper address; complete on deposit; tracking optional evidence.

rows.label: Mailed copy notation
rows.value: Date/place of mailing or unsigned affidavit/certificate.

rows.label: Separate tenant records
rows.value: Conservative separate copy/log per tenant; no numeric copy-count rule verified.

rows.label: Proof retention / Form 583
rows.value: Keep notice/log/license; Form 583 case-document purpose; no annual filing duty verified.

rows.label: Tenant challenge routes
rows.value: Failure-to-repair <=60 days; unlawful-rent petition free/no time limit.
